name: duopore-public-calendar-habit-streak
description: Work out your habit streak from the days you planned and the progress you recorded.

interface.longDescription: Work out your habit streak from the days you planned and the progress you recorded. Choose a date range and scheduled weekdays, then mark completed, missed or unknown days. Unknown days end a confirmed streak but are not marked as failures. For adults checking their own routine. The app does not monitor activity or keep a saved habit tracker.
defaultPrompt: Calculate my habit streak from these recorded days.
Keep unknown days separate from missed days in my streak check.

positive.prompt: Use Calendar Habit Streak with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"routine":"Read","start":"2026-09-28","end":"2026-10-04","scheduledWeekdays":["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri"],"completedDates":["2026-09-28","2026-09-29","2026-10-01","2026-10-02"],"missedDates":["2026-09-30"]}
